answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a violet bet on surviving 93 epochs of grading, and every island settlement recomputes the nebula schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 93 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 38 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
